authority_statement: This preregistration grants nothing. It confers no production, portfolio, model-promotion, broker-write, or trading authority. It records the frozen experiment design only; VS-002 has not been executed.

H1.inconclusive: insufficient valid independent cohorts (<10) or required arithmetic not computable
H1.not_met: computable with >=10 cohorts but either condition fails
H1.statement: Risk-adjusted signal performance exceeds the frozen risk-matched benchmark after friction.

H2.cohort_ic_population: for each greedy non-overlapping 7-day cohort: eligible non-SPY rows with valid signal_score and valid net_risk_adjusted_excess; require >=3 valid pairs, signal_score not constant, outcome not constant; compute one standard Spearman rho_cohort with average ranks for ties
H2.independent_count: number of valid cohort ICs; require >= 10 else H2_INCONCLUSIVE
H2.point_ic: equal-weight arithmetic mean of valid rho_cohort values
H2.statement: Signal score positively associated with subsequent risk-adjusted return (Spearman IC > 0).

uncertainty.method: two-sided 95% Student-t interval over the per-cohort Spearman IC values (same construction as H1)
uncertainty.role: REPORTING ONLY - does NOT change the H2 gate; a lower IC CI > 0 is NOT required

classification.criterion_binding: PREREGISTERED_CRITERIA_MET only if H1_MET AND H2_MET AND NO_ACTION_BEAT AND required independent cohort counts >= 10; PREREGISTERED_CRITERIA_NOT_MET if all required statistics are valid and sufficiently sampled but one or more binding gates fail; EVIDENCE_INCONCLUSIVE if a required binding statistic cannot be computed under the frozen rules or lacks >=10 independent cohorts
classification.null_result_note: A null/negative result is a valid experiment result, NOT an engineering failure.
classification.skill_binding: ECONOMIC_SKILL_EVIDENCE_PRESENT only when PREREGISTERED_CRITERIA_MET; otherwise ECONOMIC_SKILL_NOT_ESTABLISHED

cohort_construction.aggregation: equal-weight arithmetic mean of valid base-population rows within each selected cohort, then equal-weight arithmetic mean across cohort means; cohorts are NOT weighted by row count
cohort_construction.rule: greedy non-overlapping 7-day cohorts: a cohort date may be selected only when it is at least 7 calendar days after the previously selected cohort date; use the exact package-backed signal dates

spy_forward_join.on_no_exact_match: exclude that signal row; count and report the exclusion
spy_forward_join.rule: for each evaluated non-SPY signal row, locate the matured SPY signal row with ticker=='SPY' AND signal_time==stock.signal_time (EXACT timestamp equality); r_SPY_7d = that SPY row's recorded outcome_return_7d

forward_outcome.spy_outcome_source: recorded outcome_return_7d of the matched SPY row

hypotheses.H1_portfolio_skill: Risk-adjusted signal performance exceeds the frozen risk-matched benchmark after friction.
hypotheses.H2_ranking_skill: Signal score is positively associated with subsequent risk-adjusted return (Spearman IC > 0).
hypotheses.separation_rule: H1 and H2 are judged independently and NEVER collapsed into one statistic.

interval_method.construction: mean = mean(x); sample_sd = sqrt(sum((x_i-mean)^2)/(n-1)); se = sample_sd/sqrt(n); CI95 = mean +/- t(0.975, df=n-1)*se
interval_method.t_values: deterministic tabulated Student-t 0.975 critical values; no scipy/statsmodels

no_action.aggregation: same independent cohort structure as H1 (equal-weight within, equal-weight across)
no_action.definition: risk-free / cash return over the identical interval; does NOT use beta

population_binding.base_population: evaluated non-SPY signal rows with an EXACT matured SPY timestamp match; used by H1 and NO_ACTION so both gates operate on the same forward-outcome population
population_binding.below_min_cohorts: if exclusions reduce independent cohort count below 10 => EVIDENCE_INCONCLUSIVE
population_binding.h2_population: the scored subset of the same base population

binding_core.research_question: Do the watchlist signals predict positive risk-adjusted 7-day excess returns, and does signal strength positively rank subsequent risk-adjusted outcomes, under a sampling design that does not treat overlapping horizons as independent evidence?

risk_adjustment.beta_return_basis: dividend-adjusted daily return panel; because rf=0 the excess-vs-plain daily beta estimation is algebraically identical
risk_adjustment.pit_boundary: only bars with known_at <= signal_time may enter the window; contemporaneous and forward bars structurally excluded via the EvidenceGateway

row_arithmetic.note: subtracting identical constant friction does not alter Spearman ranks, but net_risk_adjusted_excess_pct remains the named canonical H2 outcome for consistency

freeze_digest_basis: content_hash(canonical_dumps(binding_core)); the preregistration identity changes iff ANY binding scientific rule changes
supersedes_note: Design history recorded in VS-002_blocked.json is preserved and NOT rewritten; this artifact freezes the final executable preregistration after six operator rulings.
